people.name: Haran
people.line: A city in Mesopotamia, associated with Abraham and his family.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Jacob said to them, “My relatives, where are you from?” They said, “We are from Haran.”
translations.bsb: “My brothers,” Jacob asked the shepherds, “where are you from?” “We are from Haran,” they answered.
translations.kjv: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence be ye? And they said, Of Haran
translations.asv: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence are ye? And they said, Of Haran are we.
